_comment: Classification of every upstream file. `ct extract` reads this to know where a file goes and how much liberty to take; it FAILS on an upstream file absent from this manifest, so new upstream content must be classified deliberately rather than silently skipped. portability: verbatim = copy + token substitution only; light = substitution plus small prose edits; rewrite = needs human editorial work, extract stages it under .staged/ instead of overwriting; excluded = never ported (reason required).

tiers.core: Tool- and stack-agnostic. Always installed. Process, review discipline, and the rule-governance system.
tiers.pack:node-ts: Node + TypeScript projects: service/error conventions, Zod-first shared types, vitest hygiene.
tiers.pack:sql-migrations: Numbered SQL migration files applied at boot.
tiers.pack:react-vite: React + Vite + Tailwind frontends with a shared component library.
tiers.pack:llm-tool-catalog: Platforms that expose their own REST routes as LLM tools and register primitives.
tiers.pack:docs-site: A Docusaurus-style docs site kept in sync with code.

.claude/rules/workflow.md.notes: The spine: issue -> spec -> implement -> self-audit loop, agent locking, sibling sweep, completeness traps. Tracker/VCS commands tokenize cleanly. The 'Completeness traps' section is ~60% ORM-specific chain examples (metadata bundle entity types, BullMQ queues, config.ts env vars) — those move to docs/examples/completeness-chains-orm.md and the section keeps the GENERAL rule plus a short worked example, because the rule without an example loses its teeth.

.claude/rules/response-conventions.md.notes: Single convention (end-of-response PR link). Only the repo URL tokenizes.

.claude/rules/testing.md.notes: SPLIT. Core keeps the framework-independent discipline: 'Root cause over band-aid' and its five anti-patterns, the delete-the-fix heuristic, vacuous-assertion classes (single-element ordering fixtures, explicit-option-equals-default, unverified async-ordering claims), idempotency/dedup race testing, source-scanning tripwires must strip comments. pack:node-ts keeps vitest hygiene (spy restore, env-var delete-not-reassign, partial library mocks), BullMQ jobId colon-safety, jsdom pointer-capture, react-i18next mock shape.

.claude/rules/architecture-principles.md.notes: Zero upstream references — but it is product PHILOSOPHY (the maximalist dynamic posture, ten decision rules about registries and LLM-callable behaviours), not process. A repo not building an LLM-composable platform should not inherit it. Core skills that reference it (create-spec, audit-phase) do so inside a pack-conditional block.

.claude/rules/backend-general.md.notes: Largest file (44 KB). Much of it IS portable (provenance columns at INSERT, partial-update preserve-on-absence sweeps, key-normalisation collision guards, derived-status recompute gating, fail-closed quota ledgers, dispatch tables via Map). Kysely/Fastify specifics stay because the pack declares that stack.

.claude/rules/frontend-components.md.notes: Highest coupling of any rule (46 KB, 23 refs) but the highest density of hard-won correctness patterns (re-entrancy latches, focus handoff on unmount, containment stacking contexts, i18n fallbacks). Ported as-is into the pack rather than genericised — a React shop wants the specifics.

.claude/rules/railway.md.notes: Mostly an env-var reference for one specific deployment. Ported as a WORKED EXAMPLE of the pattern (boot-gated vars documented per-service, both-processes checklist) with ORM's service names intact and a header saying so.

.claude/rules/approval-lifecycle.md.reason: A single product domain's state machine (approval processes). No portable rule survives genericisation — the value is entirely in the domain specifics.

.claude/rules/file-patterns.json.notes: Regenerated at render from the installed rule set rather than copied — the glob values are upstream paths.

.claude/rules/rule-budgets.json.reason: Byte caps must be RECOMPUTED from rendered output (+15%), never copied — rendering placeholders changes byte counts. ct render generates it.

.claude/rules/.frozen-headings.txt.reason: Generated in the target repo by build-frozen-headings.sh after render; its entries depend on which packs are installed and on the target's own source corpus.

.claude/skills/audit-phase/SKILL.md.notes: Highest-coupling skill. Its greppable checks are written against upstream paths; they become {{PATHS_SRC_GLOBS}}-driven and the stack-specific sweeps move behind pack conditionals.

.claude/skills/learn/SKILL.md.notes: Carries hard rule 6 (the regrowth gate). Its routing table is the counterpart to the budget system — both must be ported together or the budget check has no policy behind it.

.claude/skills/github-issue.md.notes: RENAMED github-issue -> tracker-issue. Also normalises a structural oddity: upstream this is a bare .md at the skills root rather than a directory with SKILL.md like every sibling.

.claude/skills/resolve-copilot-feedback/.notes: RENAMED. Copilot is one reviewer backend; the GraphQL resolveReviewThread call becomes {{VCS_RESOLVE_THREAD}} and degrades to 'reply to each thread' when the host has no resolve concept.

.claude/skills/update-context/SKILL.md.notes: Enumerates upstream's 20 context files by name. Becomes a generated list from the installed context skeleton.

.claude/skills/typecheck-all/SKILL.md.reason: Two upstream build commands in a trench coat. Replaced by the PKG_BUILD/PKG_TYPECHECK tokens, which every other skill renders inline.

.claude/agents/auditor.md.notes: Its 'Frontend Correctness Patterns Checklist' is react-vite-specific and moves behind a pack conditional; the architectural dimensions are core.

.claude/workflows/ship.js.notes: Deterministic multi-agent pipeline. REPO const and every gh invocation tokenize; the Copilot-review phase becomes conditional on VCS_LIST_REVIEW_THREADS being non-empty.

scripts/check-rule-budget.sh.notes: Already stack-agnostic. Only .claude/rules hardcoding tokenizes to {{PATHS_RULES_DIR}}.

scripts/extract-rule-headings.sh.notes: Pure stdin->stdout text transform. Ports byte-identical.

scripts/build-frozen-headings.sh.notes: Its citation corpus glob `packages/*/src` is the one upstream assumption — becomes {{PATHS_SRC_GLOBS}}.

scripts/sync-copilot-instructions.mjs.notes: RENAMED (it generates Codex + Copilot variants, not just Copilot). Emits derived instruction files for secondary agent consumers; the output targets are config-driven so a repo with no Copilot/Codex gets a no-op.

scripts/ralph.sh.notes: Headless loop driver. PROJECT_OWNER/GH_REPO consts and every gh call tokenize; the lock helpers route through TRACKER_LOCK_*.

scripts/check-migration-policy.mjs.reason: Enforces upstream's specific migration policy against its own table conventions. The generalisable half is already prose in the sql-migrations pack's rule.

.claude/settings.json.notes: Permissions allowlist. Rendered from the selected tracker/VCS/pkg tokens so a repo only grants what its own tooling needs.

(split) testing-vitest.notes: Second half of the .claude/rules/testing.md split — runner-specific hygiene. Has no standalone upstream file; ct extract does not regenerate it, so upstream changes to the vitest sections must be merged by hand.

(authored) core/root-doc.md.notes: Authored here — a lean root agent-instruction file with a stated line ceiling.

(authored) core/context/README.md.notes: Authored here — context-directory skeleton and the staleness rule.

(authored) core/settings.json.notes: Authored here — permission allowlist derived from the config's own commands.

neverPortReason: Local machine state, in-flight worktrees, and 460+ project-specific specs/context documents. The context DIRECTORY STRUCTURE is templated under core/context/ as a skeleton; its contents are never copied.
